# Chara

> Open-source, self-hostable bill splitting. No ads, no daily cap, no bank linking. Built in Stockholm.

Chara is a tool for tracking shared expenses between people who choose to share a group. It does not move money — settlement happens in your existing payment apps. The software is MIT-licensed and can be self-hosted; a hosted service is also available.
